items.t: Cruise control deactivation switch can overheat and burn (recall)
items.job: Replace cruise deactivation switch, add fused harness
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Cruise control cable can hold the throttle open (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel rail O-ring can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail pulse damper and O-ring
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Chirp or squeal from the camshaft synchronizer
items.job: Replace camshaft synchronizer and cam sensor
items.note: The synchronizer must be set to the right position or the engine will run poorly.

items.t: Timing chain rattle (4.0L SOHC)
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: The engine often has to come out. Cost rises a lot if a broken chain damaged the engine.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or harsh shifts (5R55E)
items.note: A solenoid pack or servo repair sometimes fixes shift problems for much less.

items.t: Hood latch striker can crack (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt buckle may not latch fully (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Rear differential case can crack (FX4 recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Frame flange could puncture fuel tank in a side crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect frame flange near the fuel tank
items.note: Ford's recall covers inspection and repair. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Takata air bag inflators, some under do-not-drive warnings
items.note: Some trucks are under a do-not-drive warning. Repair is free; check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Turn signals, brake lights or hazards can stop working (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can fail (recall)
items.note: The recall fix greases the motor gears; a failed motor needs replacing. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front wheel spindle can crack (4x2 recall)
items.note: Price is per side and needs an alignment after. Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Parking brake cable can come loose in cold weather (recall)
items.job: Install revised parking brake cable actuator
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel line can rub through near the throttle body (recall)
items.job: Trim heat shield and replace worn fuel line
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Harsh or delayed 10-speed shifts
items.job: Replace transmission valve body and update software
items.note: A software update and relearn fixes some trucks. Full transmission replacement costs much more.

items.t: HVAC blower motor can short out (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Gear selector may not match the actual gear (recalls)
items.job: Tighten shifter bracket or fix shift cable clip
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Tail lights can go out (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Front passenger seat belt assembly problems (recalls)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Backup camera goes blank, distorted or stuck (recalls)
items.note: Some trucks need only a free software update under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Engine block heater can crack and short (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater or install blanking plug
items.note: Do not plug in the heater until fixed. Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Front radar may be misaligned (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel line connection can loosen and leak (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Windshield may not be fully bonded (recall)
items.job: Remove and reinstall or replace windshield
items.note: Affects 2022 and 2025 trucks. Covered by Ford recalls; check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Cracked engine block (2.3L EcoBoost program)
items.note: Ford service message SSM 51754 covers some 2023 trucks; ask a dealer to check your VIN and warranty.

items.t: Driver-side lug nuts may be loose (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Do-not-drive recall; repair is free. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Front upper control arm ball joint nut loose or missing (recalls)
items.job: Tighten ball joint nut; replace parts if damaged
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Transmission may not engage Reverse or may creep (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Fuel leaks from vapor line or high-pressure pump (recalls)
items.job: Secure vapor line and replace fuel pump bolts
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Power windows may not reverse on an obstruction (recalls)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Backup camera image delayed or frozen (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Side curtain air bags can tear when they deploy (recall)
items.job: Install protective shields for curtain airbags
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Sun visor or headliner wiring can short (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair visor wiring, update software
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Front seat height-adjust bolt can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace seat height links and bolts
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Trailer module can lose communication (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Electronic brake booster can lose power assist (recalls)
items.note: Some trucks need only a free software update. Covered by Ford recalls; check your VIN.

items.t: Air bag, seat and dash assembly recalls
items.note: Priced for the dash job; the seat bolt fix is much smaller. Covered by Ford recalls; check your VIN.

items.t: EGR valve failure can cut engine power (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Internal engine failure can cause loss of power (recalls)
items.note: Covered by Ford recalls; some trucks only need an inspection. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.
